args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump to the
fix version 2.9.4, staying on the same major line to minimize risk.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the fix version; staying on the same major line (2.x) minimizes upgrade risk.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

Closes CVE-2026-31337 exposure for this service.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
